usageNotes: Use this to provision a new CephFS filesystem on an existing Ceph cluster; the target node must be a Ceph monitor/MDS-capable member and the cluster must already be initialized (OSDs and monitors up). The `name` path param defaults to `cephfs`, so only supply it when creating a second filesystem. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task API to confirm completion before mounting or using the filesystem.

examples.summary: Create the default CephFS and automatically register it as a PVE storage entry

tips: pg_num should be sized to your OSD count: a common formula is (OSDs × 100) / replicas, rounded to the nearest power of two — the metadata pool is created automatically at pg_num / 4.
Setting add-storage=true saves a manual step; it creates a `cephfs` storage entry in /etc/pve/storage.cfg pointing to the new filesystem.
A Ceph MDS daemon must be running before the filesystem becomes accessible — deploy one via the MDS endpoints if not already present.
You can only create one CephFS per cluster with the default name; use a distinct name for additional filesystems and ensure your Ceph version supports multiple active filesystems.
